title: Egyptian Sugar and Integrated Industries workers’ multi-factory wage strike
location: Edfu and Kom Ombo, Aswan; Armant, Luxor; Deshna, Qena; Hawmadiya equipment plant, Giza (plant dates differ)
participants_original: CFJ reports about 3,200 workers at Edfu/Kom Ombo and nearly 6,000 across four sites by Sep10; Al Manassa says actions spanned most company plants. Cross-site estimates are not local crowd counts.
threshold_50_evidence: Reported demands relate to minimum wage, presidential grant and state health-insurance policy; a deputy governor promised wage action. Whether sites are one protest unit remains open.

start_date.summary: Sources place first Aswan actions in August; exact day varies/unknown.

end_date.summary: Armant/Hawmadiya ended Sep7, Deshna Sep9, Edfu/Kom Ombo Sep13–14.

location.summary: CFJ lists Edfu/Kom Ombo, Armant and Deshna; Al Manassa adds Hawmadiya equipment.

scope.summary: Same company/common demands; different site dates and no single organizer proven.

demands.summary: Wage increases, arrears/allowances, presidential grant and insurance deductions.

participants_original.summary: Near 6,000 across four sites by Sep10, with about 3,200 across two Aswan sites first; not broken down by site.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: Large multi-factory strike, but cross-site total not per-site crowd estimate.

state_target.summary: Policy-linked wage/benefit demands; deputy governor discussed and promised wage action.

state_response.summary: Al Manassa reports a meeting with the Aswan deputy governor, who promised a wage increase from October and said other demands would be studied. This documents an official response/promise; implementation is not reported.

eligibility.summary: Scale/state-policy evidence exists; exact action unit and site-level threshold pending.

open_questions: One coordinated multi-site unit or separate factory actions?
What was turnout at each site simultaneously?
What were exact start/end dates per plant?
Do public forum/state target criteria apply to each?
